entries.title: Time‑Lapse Seed Germination in Transparent Soil Columns
entries.description: A row of transparent vertical soil cylinders holds small seed spheres that swell, crack, and emit branching root and shoot tubes that slowly grow, bend toward a light source, and push aside soil particles shown as small brown spheres.
